message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, driven by growth in commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government markets [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million for the same period, reflecting expansion across semiconductor, general electronics, automotive, and energy markets [D1]. Total segment revenue reached $1,846 million, representing a year-over-year increase supported by strong performance in both reportable segments [D1]. Operating income for the Communications Solutions Group increased to $458 million from $246 million in the prior year period [D1].
